transcript.content: Hello, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

I'm just really struggling with how horrible my skin looks lately. I have these terrible acne scars and breakouts that completely ruin my face, and it's making me incredibly anxious. I just feel so overwhelmed by how bad it looks.
How much time each day do you spend thinking about your skin, and have other people told you that it looks normal or not nearly as bad as you feel it does?

I easily spend several hours a day obsessing over my skin and constantly checking it. My family and friends always tell me it looks completely normal and that they can barely see anything, but I feel like they're just being nice, which makes me constantly ask them for reassurance.
Over the past two weeks, have you been feeling down most of the day or lost interest in things you usually enjoy?
I haven't really thought about that, to be honest. My mind is just so completely focused on my skin and how awful it looks. Any distress I feel is really just because of my appearance.
Besides your skin, do you find yourself worrying excessively about many other parts of your life, like work, health, money, or family, on most days?
No, I don't really worry about those other areas like work, money, or my family. Almost all of my anxiety and focus is just on my skin and how bad it looks.
Because of your skin concerns, do you do things like repeatedly check mirrors, pick at your skin, camouflage it, or avoid people or activities?

Yes, I constantly check myself in the mirror and end up picking at my skin for hours trying to 'fix' the flaws, which usually just makes it worse. I also spend a massive amount of time using heavy makeup to camouflage my face because I feel so incredibly self-conscious.
